gloss_en: Exporting main model plus linked model to same IFC fails with non-recoverable error when Pset schedules are enabled.

gloss_en: When exporter dies with unrecoverable error user gets no IFC; please skip bad elements and report them.

answer_summary: Maintainers: per-element failures are already skipped; the abort happens for failures outside the element loop.

gloss_en: Exporter fails even on new empty project; only rolling back to 2022.5.1 works.

answer_summary: Rollback to previous add-in version used as workaround.

gloss_en: After upgrading 2020 to 2023 every export gives 'unrecoverable error ... file too large' even for a 5-wall model.

question_paraphrase: Built-in and GitHub exporters all give the 'unrecoverable error... may be because the file is too large' on tiny models; multi-user license; 2020 worked.
phrasing_notes: calls the message 'well-known'; asks for pointers
answer_summary: Respondent: older Enscape versions blocked export; upgrade Enscape or disable interfering add-ins; test with a blank model.

gloss_en: Nothing is exported when Revit UI language is switched to Spanish/ENU.

gloss_en: Revit freezes and crashes right after starting IFC export with standard options.

gloss_en: Converting a specific IFC to Fragments gives 'RuntimeError: Aborted(native code called abort())'; 0.0.78 gives BindingError StreamMeshes 4 args vs 3.

answer_summary: Version mismatch between wrapper and wasm; pin matching versions; fixed later.

gloss_en: GetLine() decodes Chinese incorrectly for \X2\7d20586b571f\X0\ but correctly when hex is uppercase.

answer_summary: Fix: accept a-f in the hex decoder in string_parsing.cpp.

gloss_en: IfcConvert to XML fails with 'wstring_convert: to_bytes error' on accented chars in FILE_NAME header.

gloss_en: IfcConvert to XML aborts with 'Token $ at 191018 invalid string' because IFCRELDEFINESBYPROPERTIES has $ everywhere.

gloss_en: Regression: IfcConvert ifc to xml gives '[Error] Index 2 is out of range for variant of size 2' in 0.8.4/0.8.5 but not 0.8.1.

question_paraphrase: Works on 0.8.1, fails on newer with variant index error.
